name: Blotter
requirements: Runs on macOS, Linux or Windows with WSL2, with git. The installer brings Node when it is missing, and rer brings pnpm.

page.title: Run Blotter
page.description: Run Blotter on your computer. 100% free and open source.
page.heading: Run Blotter on your computer.
page.intro: 100% free and open source. Two lines, and Blotter opens in your browser.

steps.title: Install rer
steps.note: It installs rer for you alone, with its own Node if you have none. It changes no shell settings: if it prints an export PATH=… line, run that line before step 2.

steps.title: Start Blotter
steps.note: rer gets Blotter, installs everything, makes you the owner and prints a link that opens Blotter signed in. To start it again later: cd run-blotter && rer dev. Already have Node 22 or later? npx -y @runeditrun/rer dev just-every/run-blotter does both steps in one line.

page.next: Open the link rer dev prints on this computer and confirm Finish setup. Keep that sign-in link private.
page.stopLabel: Stop Blotter when you are done:
